privacyReport.title: Verified Privacy
privacyReport.description: No data leaves your browser. Processing occurs entirely on your device using Web Crypto API, WebAssembly, and other cutting-edge modern technologies.

howItWorks.title: How it works?
howItWorks.background-remover: Uses the 'RMBG' AI model running locally in your browser via the ONNX Runtime Web library. Image processing happens on your CPU/GPU without sending anything to external servers.
howItWorks.file-decompressor: Uses JSZip and js-untar libraries to read the binary structure of compressed files directly in the browser's memory, allowing individual file extraction.
howItWorks.media-compressor: Employs FFmpeg compiled for WebAssembly (WASM). This brings the power of the world's most used video processing tool inside your browser.
howItWorks.file-encryptor: Uses the browser's native Web Crypto API with the 256-bit AES-GCM algorithm. The password is derived using PBKDF2 with 100,000 iterations of SHA-256.
howItWorks.hash-generator: Makes use of the 'subtle.digest' function of the Web Crypto API to calculate the SHA-256 hash of texts or files instantly and securely.
howItWorks.file-compressor: Uses the JSZip library to create a new compressed file in memory, packaging the selected files with the maximum level of DEFLATE compression.
howItWorks.word-counter: Applies regular expressions and JavaScript string processing logic to analyze the text and calculate detailed statistics in real-time.
howItWorks.file-converter: Combines Canvas API for images and PDF.js for documents, allowing conversion of visual formats without depending on cloud processing.
howItWorks.image-resizer: Uses the browser's Canvas API to redraw the image at the specified new dimensions, applying interpolation algorithms to maintain quality.
howItWorks.json-formatter: Uses native JSON.parse and JSON.stringify methods with custom indentation to validate and organize JSON data structures instantly.
howItWorks.qr-generator: Employs dot matrix generation algorithms to convert strings into visual QR Code patterns, rendering the result on a canvas for download.
howItWorks.exif-extractor: Uses the exifr library to read image binary buffers and extract hidden metadata like GPS coordinates, camera model, and exposure settings.

faq.a: Yes, SLIT.IO offers completely free and unlimited background removal, with no hidden fees or watermarks.

faq.a: Never. Your password and files never leave your computer. If you forget your password, we cannot recover your data.

faq.a: Yes, because you don't 'send' anything. Encryption happens in your browser. It's like using local software, but without installing anything.

hash-generator.title: Secure Online SHA-256 Hash Generator

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: SLIT.IO is built on a foundation of privacy. This policy explains how we handle your data — or more precisely, how we don't.
privacyPage.section1: SLIT.IO does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All tools process files and text entirely within your browser using client-side JavaScript and WebAssembly. No data ever leaves your device.
privacyPage.section2: When you use any tool on SLIT.IO — whether compressing an image, encrypting a file, counting words, or removing a background — the processing happens 100% locally in your web browser. Your files are never uploaded to any server.
privacyPage.section3: We use Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights, which collect anonymous, aggregated page-view and performance metrics (such as page load time). This data is non-personal and cannot be used to identify individual users. No cookies are set for analytics purposes.
privacyPage.section4: SLIT.IO uses only a single local storage entry to remember your theme preference (light/dark mode). No tracking cookies are used.
privacyPage.section5: Some tools download processing models (such as ONNX models for background removal) from third-party CDNs. These downloads are anonymous — no personal information is sent. No other third-party services have access to your data.
privacyPage.section6: If you have questions about this privacy policy, you can reach us through the feedback form.

aboutPage.title: About SLIT.IO
aboutPage.description: SLIT.IO is an open collection of web utilities that run entirely in your browser. Fast, secure, and private.
aboutPage.mission: To provide powerful, free, and privacy-respecting web tools that anyone can use without installing software or creating accounts.
aboutPage.how: Every tool uses modern web technologies — JavaScript, WebAssembly, Canvas, and the Web Crypto API — to process your files directly in your browser. Nothing is ever sent to a server.
aboutPage.openSource: SLIT.IO is open source. You can view the code, report issues, or contribute on GitHub.
aboutPage.feedback: Have a suggestion, found a bug, or want to collaborate? We'd love to hear from you.
